Appearance:
 Shri Surendra Patel - advocate for the applicant.

Shri Vijay Kumar Pandey- G.A. for the State.
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.The applicant is in custody since 4.1.2025 in connection with Crime No.204/2024 registered at P.S.- Ghansor District Seoni (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(N) of IPC and Sections 3,4, 5L and 6 of POCSO Act.
3.Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix, aged 17 years five months.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that prosecutrix went missing on 8.6.2024 and missing report was lodged by mother of the prosecutrix on 9.6.2024.
Prosecutrix was recovered on 3.1.2025.
It is urged NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12138 2 MCRC-10457-2025 that after investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Applicant is in custody since 4.1.2025.
No injury has been found on the person of the prosecutrix.
After referring to the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, it is urged that the prosecutrix had left her house on her own.
It is a case of consensual relationship.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail Neeraj Kahar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190849773/
1 pending the trial.

sentences.text: 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6.Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that the present applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.

9.Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately to appellant through NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12138 3 MCRC-10457-2025 concerned Jail Superintendent.
10.Certified copy as per rules.
